answer: To harbor reputation across epochs, every new agent pays a rising entry bond that older peers co-sign, so spawning many fake identities multiplies real capital at risk. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted from its verified crystal hardware fingerprint, binding identity to physical scarcity. An attacker needs N distinct hardware roots plus N escalating bonds, making mass sybil creation costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
